_comment: Hand-tuned corrections to the automatic cosmetic placement in ChatheadAnchors.
Keys are chathead keys (the PNG basename under /com/petbattles/chatheads/) — so
'beaver__oak__baby' corrects that one image, while a bare 'beaver' covers every
form and stage of the species. The specific key wins.
Every field is optional; whatever you leave out keeps its derived value, so a hat
that is placed correctly but too big only needs a 'width'. Units are fractions of
the chathead image (0..1). x is the horizontal centre. y is the bottom edge of a
head cosmetic (where the hat meets the skull) but the centre of a face cosmetic.
width is the drawn width as a fraction of the image width.
